abilities.name: Readings of the Future
abilities.description: This unit can use its Shooting ability even if it has used the Run or Retreat abilities this round.

abilities.name: Charging Volley
abilities.description: Declare an enemy unit that you are not in combat with to be the target of this ability. This unit can use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase against that target. You must then charge against that unit.

abilities.name: Mercenary Training
abilities.description: You can use one point of personal wealth on this unit to increase each tokens health by 1, their control by 2, and their movement by 2. Furthermore, all of the weapons of that unit gain Crit (Auto-wound).

abilities.name: Defensive Wall
abilities.description: If this unit did not charge this turn, all of its weapons have the Strike-First property.

abilities.name: Mercenary Training
abilities.description: You can use one point of personal wealth on this unit to increase each tokens health by 1, their control by 2, and their movement by 2. Furthermore, all of the weapons of that unit gain Crit (Auto-wound).

abilities.name: Glorious Martyrs
abilities.description: Each time a model is slain in a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is within 12" of a unit controlled by Demir. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit at the end of the Fight phase.

abilities.name: Psionic Defenses
abilities.description: The horde focuses its psionic energy onto an enemy unit, confusing it. Choose an enemy unit that the Thrikreen can see within 12" and do a casting roll of 2d6: if you roll higher than (12 - the number of tokens in this unit)+, the chosen target gains a -1 on its hit rolls and -1 on its save rolls until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Psionic Flexibility
abilities.description: The Horde can use its ranged weapons as if they were melee weapons during the fight phase.

abilities.name: Skittering disappearance
abilities.description: Remove all tokens of this unit from the battlefield, and place a skittering-hole token in the place of one of the tokens.

abilities.name: Skittering reapparition
abilities.description: Redeploy all tokens of this unit within 6" of any skittering-hole token.

abilities.name: Firing line
abilities.description: If this unit has not moved this round and was not deployed at the start of the turn, add 1 to the attack characteristic of this unit's Muskets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Curved Armored Plating
abilities.description: When saving against wounds from Archery attacks, this unit can add +1 on its save roll.
